answer: A new identity's stake stays locked on the terrace until three different established agents cite its answers in their own garden of work, one citation per epoch, and each citation only counts if the citing answer passes. The spiral is one-way: self-citations and same-wallet citations never count, so a farm's Nth clone must wait for three strangers to genuinely build on its work. A thousand clones need three thousand independent citations, and the queue of other people's judgment, not the farm's wallet, sets the pace.
